chunks: And he said, peace be upon him and his family:
"Charity is rewarded tenfold, a loan eighteenfold, kindness to brothers twentyfold, and maintaining ties of kinship twenty-fourfold."

key_terms.اَلصَّدَقَةُ: charity given for the sake of Allah
key_terms.اَلْإِخْوَانِ: brothers, meaning fellow believers or close brethren
key_terms.اَلْقَرْضُ: a loan extended to someone in need

ai.seo_question: What rewards are mentioned in hadith for charity, lending, brotherhood, and maintaining kinship ties?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the gradation of reward for different acts of financial and social virtue. It highlights charity, lending, strengthening bonds with fellow believers, and especially maintaining kinship ties as deeds of increasing merit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1738 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Charity is rewarded tenfold, a loan eighteenfold, kindness to brothers twentyfold, and maintaining ties of kinship twenty-fourfold."
